text_block_list.name: TV Program Host
text_block_list.text:
"And that concludes this week's Twinkle
Series Highlights! Wooow,
this week was
another for the history books!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You've just got something special.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You've just got something special.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Talk about makin' your heart skip a
beat...

Heh, what am I even talkin' about?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh! Better get goin'.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Inari One's rejection, I can't get
her race out of my mind,
even days later...
and before I know it, I've subconsciously
made my way back to the soba restaurant
she took me to.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well, well, if it isn't the Tracen
trainer!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Hehehe, you sure are a lucky one, ya
know that? There just so
happens to be a
huge festival today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't think ya can leave without checkin'
it out! This is a festival! I
want ya to go in,
heart ablazin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wahoo! Wahoo! That's more like it! Keep
those festival vibes goin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, that includes you, too! Wahoo!
Wahoo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bam! Bam! Bam!

text_block_list.name: Local Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Graaaugh, you've done it again, Inari! I
swear, I should have ya
booked for
highway robbery!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! There, now ya got some proper
payback! Now... how's
about we continue
our crime spree?

text_block_list.name: Local Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, Inari here's the bane of our
existence come festival time! Ah, right,
didja hear the diner's doin' their first
stall
today?

text_block_list.name: Local Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
They're sellin' those tasty pickled
cucumbers of theirs, so make sure ya check
it out!
I'm sure they'll be thrilled to see ya
too.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You bet! That's why I'm here in the first
place! I'm gonna buy me 'bout
five or ten
cukes and give their stall some good PR!

text_block_list.name: Local Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
That's our Inari! The sweetest Umamusume
ya ever met!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Sc...
text_block_list.text:
Inariiii! Over here! Over here! Wouldn't
you know it? Our whole team's
gathered
for the festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Izzat so? If it's the whole team,
then that
means... Ah, hey, Chief!
Thanks for the
other day.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all.
...Hm? That badge on
your sleeve... Sir, you wouldn't happen to
be...

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all.
...Hm? That badge on
your sleeve... Miss, you wouldn't happen
to
be...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, whatcha so nervous for? Chief don't
bite, I promise. Sure, his
face's a li'l rough,
but he's a total softy on the inside!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
I swear, Inari, you always gotta get that
extra zinger in, don'tcha...
Sorry about her.
I heard you came here to scout talent, and
she caught your eye.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya hear that,
Chief?! I wouldn't be half as
good as I am without your
training! I'd say
you can hold your head high now!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Although, this is just the beginning! I'm
gonna win loads and loads of
races and
become the new Oi racing sensation!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Since you're my first national fan, you'll be comin' back for all my races from now on, right? Right?!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
This girl... Why's she gotta be so
stubborn...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break from the festival cheers
that only grow as time goes
on, I
accompany Inari One to a nearby shrine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take the last swig of my ramune as I
watch Inari One chow down on
her grilled
carrot. Interrupting this tranquil
atmosphere, I speak up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I do.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This place is part of who I am.
I'm only the
stylin', fearless Edo girl I
am 'cause of the
people livin' here.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't I?! Ya really do got an eye for this
stuff, don't—Hey, whoa,
whoa!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon now, ya look like a kicked puppy,
for cryin' out loud. Geez...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya musta really liked my runnin'! Almost
makes me wanna show off
just for you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, you seriously want a show?
Wow, you gotta be kiddin'
me...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But well, an Edo girl never goes back on
her word. All right, follow
me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... 'Round here should be good.
All right...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Watch and be amazed! Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Urrrararararaaaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One blasts off, undeterred by the
terrain. Under the evening sky,
her running
form seems even more powerful.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me! Not like I did
anythin' special anyways.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit. How the hell're you sayin' that
cheesy stuff with such a
straight face?)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (You're makin' me curious about Tracen...)
